senses.gloss: m. (טְרַד; cmp. Arab. mitrad, hasta brevis) the hunter’s spear.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 36:39">Targ. Y. II, Gen. XXXVI, 39</cite> (play on <he>מטרד</he>, <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 36:39">ib.</cite>) <he>גברא דהוה לעי במ׳ וכ׳</he> (‘Rashi’ to <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 83">Gen. R. s. 83</cite> quotes: <he>גברא טָרוֹדָא דהוה לעולם כמטרידא</he>, read: <he>לעי במ׳</he>) a (busy) man, for all his life-time he worked with the hunting spear; Y. I <he>במ׳ ובסרדיתא</he> with hunting spear and with net; <cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 1:50">Targ. I Chr. I, 50</cite> <he>במִטְרְדוּתָא ובסרדותא</he>.
